description: This Java class `InMemorySamplingService` implements an in-memory sampling service that tracks durations associated with different keys for performance diagnostics. It extends `AbstractSamplingService` and provides methods to take samples, retrieve sampling data, and reset stored measurements.

classes.name: InMemorySamplingService
classes.description: A service for collecting and managing performance sampling data in memory, tracking durations associated with specific keys, and providing mechanisms to retrieve and reset this data.

methods.name: InMemorySamplingService
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the service with a specified sampling rate.

methods.name: getSamplingData
methods.description: Returns the collected sampling data encapsulated in a `SamplingData` object.

methods.name: takeSample
methods.description: Records a sampling duration associated with a specific key, merging it into existing data.
